prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1357; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle was inspected at the shop following a left-turn collision. The front quarter panel, bumper cover, and headlamp assembly show damage consistent with the impact described. Repairs will include panel replacement, refinishing, and a headlamp swap, with labor hours matching the extent of the work. The estimate lines contain no duplicate charges. No prior damage to this vehicle has come to light, and the repair plan is recommended as submitted.
